statement:
For a Noetherian open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$, define the *coherent pro-extension-by-zero* functor $Rj_!:D_{\mathrm{Coh}}^b(\mathcal O_U)\to\operatorname{Pro}(D_{\mathrm{Coh}}^b(\mathcal O_X))$ by assigning to $K$ the pro-isomorphism class of a Deligne system $(\mathcal I^n\mathcal F^\bullet)$ whose restriction to $U$ is $K$. This is not the usual extension-by-zero of sheaves. It is characterized by $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{Pro}}(Rj_!K,L)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_U(K,L|_U)$ for coherent bounded $L$ on $X$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a *proper* map of Noetherian schemes, let $V\subset Y$ be open, and let $U=f^{-1}(V)$. Write $j:U\hookrightarrow X$, $j':V\hookrightarrow Y$, and $g=f|_U:U\to V$ (proper). Then there is a canonical natural isomorphism of functors
\[
Rj'_!\circ Rg_*\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_*\circ Rj_!:D_{\mathrm{Coh}}^b(\mathcal O_U)\to\operatorname{Pro}(D_{\mathrm{Coh}}^b(\mathcal O_Y)),
\]
where $Rf_*$ is applied termwise to coherent pro-objects. Thus coherent pro-extension by zero commutes with proper pushforward in the cartesian open square.
hypotheses: Proper Noetherian f, inverse image U=f^{-1}(V) of open V, coherent pro-extension Rj_! defined.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-well-defined-pre}
Let $f : X \to Y$ be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes.
Let $V \subset Y$ be an open subscheme and set $U = f^{-1}(V)$.
Picture
$$
\xymatrix{
U \ar[r]_j \ar[d]_g & X \ar[d]^f \\
V \ar[r]^{j'} & Y
}
$$
Then we have a canonical isomorphism $Rj'_! \circ Rg_* \to Rf_* \circ Rj_!$
of functors $D^b_{\textit{Coh}}(\mathcal{O}_U) \to
\text{Pro-}D^b_{\textit{Coh}}(\mathcal{O}_Y)$ where
$Rj_!$ and $Rj'_!$ are as in Remark \ref{remark-extension-by-zero}.
